fusions.name: Single Report
fusions.desc: Fires a single sting that deals 32 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Buckshot Swarm
fusions.desc: Blasts a cone of stingers that deals 10 damage to everything in it and knocks them back 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighted In
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 12 seconds. An escort of stingers fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hang Fire
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
